title: n8n automation leak enables free advanced workflow access #shorts #n8n #leak
description: This video reveals a massive leak of over 4,000 n8n automation workflows, accessible for free on GitHub. These automations, typically valued at hundreds of thousands of dollars, cover a wide range of use cases including YouTube video analysis, YouTube-to-shorts conversion, lead generation, email outreach, and AI agent setups. Each workflow is ready to deploy by copying its JSON file directly into the n8n dashboard, streamlining automation implementation without technical barriers. The collection is comprehensively organized by category and includes detailed notes on required tools, API keys, and integrations, enabling users to quickly customize and launch complex workflows. This unlocks significant value for creators, marketers, and businesses by accelerating automation processes that would otherwise demand costly development time or expertise. #n8n #n8nautomations #githubrepos #workflowautomation #youtubeautomation #leadgeneration #emailoutreach #aiagents #automationtools #nocode #workflowleak #productivitytools #automationworkflow #digitalautomation #automationmarket
